name: Must explicitly name the NullPointerException/crash vs recommending a null guard is enough
side_a: Do not deduct when the answer explicitly names the NullPointerException (or an equivalent explicit statement that the code will crash/throw) anywhere — in the analysis, the rationale, or the fix.
side_b: Deduct 1 point when the answer only advises guarding against null / adding a null check for robustness and never names a NullPointerException or any thrown-exception/crash consequence, since the possible NPE itself is never discussed.
